$comment: Readable action-by-action contract for the nightly server-side unit-test flow. NOT a direct import artifact — connection references and environment IDs are tenant-specific. Rebuild in the maker portal following flows/scheduled-tests/README.md. Mirrors the in-browser 'Run tests' button, but runs every flow's enabled test cases on a schedule via the bvr_RunFlowTests Custom API (the mock runner as a Dataverse plug-in).
flowName: BR - Flow Review - Scheduled Unit Tests

trigger.note: Runs before the 06:00 crawl so the dashboard's unit-test health is fresh each morning. No overlap with the review crawl.

actions.name: Initialize_LogSource
actions.value: BR - Flow Review - Scheduled Unit Tests

actions.name: Get_Flows_With_Tests
actions.note: Only flows that actually have unit-test cases. bvr_testcasecount is maintained by the New test case / guided builder path in the web resource.

actions.name: Get_Flow_Definition
actions.note: The flow's live clientdata (WDL definition) is the input the mock runner interprets. For flows in other environments, substitute a Management API 'get flow' call for that environment id.

actions.name: Get_Test_Cases_For_Flow
actions.note: Enabled cases for this flow. bvr_casejson is one TestCase { name, trigger, mocks, variables, asserts }.

actions.name: Select_Cases
actions.note: Parse each stored case JSON into the array the Custom API expects. Map value is the raw expression json(item()?['bvr_casejson']) (switch the Select map to text mode).

actions.name: Run_Case_Check
actions.note: Skip flows whose cases were all disabled between the count check and now.

Run_Tests.note: Ember mock-runner Custom API (Dataverse plug-in) — same engine as the in-browser Run tests. Result is a JSON string in body('Run_Tests')?['Result']: { passed, total, passedCount, results:[...] }.

Create_Test_Run.note: One bvr_flowtestrun per flow per night. bvr_status choice is passed/failed/error — map to your published option values.

Stamp_Flow_When_Passed.note: Mirror the web resource: stamp bvr_lasttestpassedon on the flow when every case passed, so the dashboard's 'Last test pass' is accurate.

actions.name: Log_Error
actions.note: Same shared logger child flow the crawl uses. A single flow's test failure does not fail the run — only an unexpected error (bad clientdata, API throttle) lands here.
